page.layout: One printed page on the scan, blank except for handwriting and stains. Handwritten marks in the left-hand page area and in the right-hand margin area are not printed text.
page.notes: Page is blank apart from manuscript flourishes and abstract pen marks (apparently scribal practice or a cancelled line of short strokes in the centre-right, reading as "Ly", "Lss", "Ly", "Lyps", "Om", "Mit", "Ly", "Lyy"). These are handwriting, not print, and are therefore not transcribed. Ink blots and water stains cover much of the left half. The right-hand edge shows show-through or the neighbouring page's handwriting, also not transcribed.
